title: Biennial controlled-substance inventory
rule_summary: After the initial inventory, each registrant must take a new controlled-substance inventory at least every two years.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply biennial inventory requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing biennial inventory with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
